kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننبهر (form VII)
# نَنْبَهِرُ (nanbahiru) /nan.ba.hi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# نَنْبَهِرَ (nanbahira) /nan.ba.hi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# نَنْبَهِرْ (nanbahir) /nan.ba.hir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
